data_scope.provider: Binance USD-M public production market-data endpoints

feature_scaler.method: deterministic uniformly sampled training-only median, interquartile range, 0.1/99.9 percentiles, and standard deviation with a 250000-event fit ceiling
feature_scaler.zero_or_near_zero_training_scale_policy: leave binary features unchanged and set constant continuous features to zero

event_pooling_mlp.summary: last event, causal-window mean, and causal-window dispersion
event_pooling_mlp.role: simple nonlinear baseline and complexity control

causal_event_tcn.role: bounded causal temporal candidate preserving subsecond event order

heads: after-cost-payoff quantiles by horizon and side
maximum-adverse-excursion quantiles by horizon and side
positive-after-cost-payoff probability by horizon and side
adverse-selection probability by horizon and side

training_loss.probability_heads: numerically stable binary cross entropy from logits

entry_and_exit.reason: L2 does not identify own queue position, cancellation priority, or hidden liquidity

costs.funding_crossing_policy: censor until an account-specific funding target is implemented
costs.account_fee_source: authenticated read-only account commission evidence or hash-bound operator configuration
costs.runtime_fee_mismatch_policy: model bundle is incompatible and cannot trade

prospective_evaluation_contract.quiet_qualification_run_status: design-consumed feature diagnostic; permanently ineligible as sealed financial confirmation
required_model_metrics: pinball loss by horizon, side, symbol, and activity regime
Brier score and calibration for probability heads
directional balanced accuracy and Matthews correlation coefficient
after-cost net return, annualized return, Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, maximum drawdown, expected shortfall, profit factor, and turnover
performance sensitivity to fees, latency, spread, depth, slippage, and missed fills
promotion_requires: positive after-cost lower confidence bound on the sealed aggregate
no symbol or activity regime with an unacceptable loss concentration
drawdown and expected-shortfall gates for the selected risk profile
the simplest candidate when evidence is statistically indistinguishable
